originalTitle: Brother of Muslim police cadet killed in 9/11 'disappointed' by calls for Mamdani to sit out memorial
summary: Zeshan Hamdani speaks out after push back against New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani, who is Muslim, attending 9/11 events.
content:
This year’s 25th anniversary of the September 11th attacks has become embroiled in divisive politics. There are controversial calls for the city’s first Muslim Mayor to sit out the commemorative event, including from Rudy Giuliani who was New York’s mayor on the morning of 9/11.

Mayor Zohran Mamdani has said he will attend and his focus will be on the families who lost loved ones.

Zeshan Hamdani lost his older brother Salman, a Muslim American New York police cadet, in the North Tower. He spoke to the BBC's Nada Tawfik over his thoughts on this anniversary.

Video filmed and edited by Andrew Blum; produced by Pratiksha Ghildial
chineseTitle: 9/11 事件中被杀的穆斯林警察学员的兄弟对要求马姆达尼坐在纪念馆外的呼吁感到“失望”
chineseSummary: 泽尚·哈姆达尼 (Zeshan Hamdani) 在反击穆斯林市长佐赫兰·马姆达尼 (Zohran Mamdani) 参加 9/11 活动后发表讲话。
chineseContent:
今年是 9 月 11 日袭击事件 25 周年纪念日，已陷入分裂的政治之中。有人呼吁该市首位穆斯林市长缺席纪念活动，这一呼吁颇具争议，其中包括 9/11 上午担任纽约市长的鲁迪·朱利安尼 (Rudy Giuliani)。

市长佐兰·马姆达尼 (Zohran Mamdani) 表示他将出席，重点关注失去亲人的家庭。

泽山·哈姆达尼 (Zeshan Hamdani) 在北塔失去了他的哥哥萨尔曼 (Salman)，萨尔曼是美国穆斯林纽约警察学员。他与 BBC 的 Nada Tawfik 谈论了他对这个周年纪念日的想法。

视频由安德鲁·布鲁姆拍摄和编辑；普拉蒂克沙·吉迪亚尔制片的作品
